intro: The Serra Residences is a condominium in District 11, in the Novena, Dunearn and Shelford belt. Our project file records a launch in October 2026 from a third-party new-launch list. This entry is not officially confirmed, so unit counts, tenure and that launch month are left out of the facts below, and no TOP or key date is confirmed. Some listings describe the tenure as freehold; we are not repeating that figure until it can be cited from the developer or URA. Your sale documents are the source of truth. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your The Serra Residences renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your The Serra Residences interior
sections.text:
District 11 owners often want a quiet, residential interior rather than a hotel look: considered materials, storage that disappears into the walls, and bedrooms that are fully fitted. The work Maison would start with, once the approved plan is in hand, is built-in carpentry — an entry cabinet, a living-room joinery wall, a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry, and full-height wardrobes, including a headboard wall in the main bedroom if the plan allows it. We do not specify loose, flat-pack furniture as the main look, and we are happy to work in closer photographs of a wardrobe, a stone counter or a fluted panel as well as a wide room view.

No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed. Watten House and Dunearn House are the other District 11 pages in this batch; use them as nearby links, not as a stand-in for your drawings. We will not invent walking times to Novena, to the Bukit Timah corridor, or to any MRT station. Check your stack, facing and the management rules before you plan blinds, a window seat or a desk under a window.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and obtain renovation approval before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial figure, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan when you have it. We are an independent designer and are not affiliated with the developer.
